summary: The 12-month Enrollment survey covers activity from July 1, 2006, through June 30, 2007, with institutions reporting their enrollment and instructional activity over that full period rather than at a single census date. It covers eligible IPEDS institutions and reports activity for undergraduate and graduate students; the measures are especially useful for institutions with nontraditional calendars or short-term programs.

Fall Enrollment collects institution-reported enrollment for traditional academic calendars as of October 15 or the institution’s official fall reporting date; institutions with program-based or continuous calendars report students enrolled at any time from August 1 through October 31. Records describe students enrolled at participating postsecondary institutions, with multiple records per institution when a table’s breakdown dimensions require them. Most tables cover the institution’s reported fall enrollment, while some measures have narrower eligibility or optional reporting noted in the table summaries.

Finance is an annual collection of financial statements for the completed institutional fiscal year, reported using the institution’s applicable accounting standards rather than a calendar-year reporting period. The unit of observation is an eligible postsecondary institution in the IPEDS universe, with finance forms separated by public GASB institutions, FASB-reporting institutions, and private for-profit institutions; component-unit files instead describe legally separate units associated with public GASB institutions. The component covers institutional revenues, expenditures, assets, liabilities, and related financial information, subject to the accounting-model and institution-type restrictions of each form.

Graduation Rates reports outcomes for cohorts of full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates at eligible postsecondary institutions, with student status measured as of August 31, 2007. Reporting focuses on completion within 150% of normal time and may also include transfer-out status; records are institution-level cohort outcomes rather than individual student records. The 2007 collection uses the older race/ethnicity categories.

Human Resources covers institution-level staff and employee reporting, with fall staffing measured on the November 1 payroll and salary and benefits reported for the 2007-08 academic year. Tables use multiple records per institution, with eligibility varying by staff population and institution type. Reporting race/ethnicity and gender was optional in even-numbered years; because 2007 is odd-numbered, the race/ethnicity-and-gender tables have data available under the old race/ethnicity categories.

The Institutional Characteristics survey is collected for the 2007-08 academic year and reports institution-level information for institutions in the 2007 IPEDS universe. IPEDS reporting is mandatory for institutions participating in Title IV federal financial aid programs; records may represent a parent institution or multiple-campus reporting arrangement, and some fields apply only to eligible institutions or programs.
